full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white photograph shows four dark human figures standing in a bright, enclosed interior. The nearest person occupies the left foreground in profile, wearing a long dark coat or dress and holding hands close to the body. Across the room, two smaller figures stand near the center at different depths. A taller figure at the right edge leans slightly inward, but the head and shoulders dissolve into motion blur. The floor and lower wall are darker gray, while the rear wall glows almost white. A few faint architectural lines suggest a corner and a low horizontal seam, yet the space remains mostly undefined. Long exposure or intentional camera movement causes each person to leave soft streaks, especially around faces and hair. Their bodies remain legible as upright black shapes, but details of identity and clothing fade into shadow. The strong light appears to come from behind or above the central group, creating a luminous backdrop and deep silhouettes. A pale flare spreads from the upper center, and a narrow bright area enters along the left border. The camera viewpoint is low enough that the people rise dramatically into the light, while the close left and right forms make a loose frame around the smaller middle figures. The composition is sparse, with broad tonal fields rather than many objects. Deep black garments, silvery blurred edges, and blown highlights create a theatrical, unsettled atmosphere. The scene feels like a fleeting encounter in a real room, caught at an exposure long enough to make movement visible without making the figures disappear entirely.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形黑白照片呈现四个深色人形站在明亮而封闭的室内。最近人物占据左前景侧面，穿长深色外套或裙装，双手靠近身体。房间对面，两名较小人物在中央不同纵深站立。右边缘一名较高人物略向内倾，但头肩消融在运动模糊中。地板与下墙较深灰，后墙则亮得近乎白色。几道模糊建筑线暗示墙角和低位水平接缝，空间其余部分基本不明确。长曝光或刻意移动相机使每个人留下柔和拖痕，脸和头发周围尤其明显。身体仍可读为直立黑形，但身份与衣着细节没入阴影。强光似乎来自中央人物身后或上方，形成发亮背景和深剪影。浅光晕从上中央铺开，左边缘亦进入一条窄亮区域。相机视点较低，让人物在光前显得高耸，近处左右形体为中央较小人物组成松散框架。构图稀疏，以宽阔色调区域而非众多物件为主。深黑衣着、银色模糊边缘和过曝亮处形成戏剧化、不安的气氛。场景像真实房间里转瞬的相遇，以足够长的曝光看见运动，却未让人形完全消失。
style_prompt_en: Experimental black-and-white photography uses strong backlight, dark silhouettes, and controlled motion blur to make a real space feel uncertain. Let upright forms remain readable while heads, edges, and gestures trail into silver-gray streaks. A nearly white central field is held by deep black margins and sparse architectural lines. Long exposure or camera movement supplies the softness; avoid crisp descriptive detail everywhere. Low viewpoint and foreground framing create layers of scale. The tonal design is severe and theatrical, with a fleeting, dreamlike sense of human presence.
style_prompt_zh: 实验性黑白摄影以强逆光、深剪影和受控运动模糊使真实空间显得不确定。直立形体仍可辨，头、边缘和手势则拖成银灰痕线。近白中央区域由深黑边缘和稀疏建筑线约束。长曝光或相机移动提供柔化；不要处处清楚描述。低视点和前景框景制造尺度层次。色调设计严峻而戏剧化，带转瞬、梦境般的人类存在感。
theme_en: Four blurred dark figures in a bright enclosed room
theme_zh: 明亮封闭房间中四个模糊暗色身影
name: Alex Majoli
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
